}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== See also [[Arcadyan ARV7519]]
*[http://ayuda.orange.es/internet/configuracion-y-descargas/routers-y-modems/nuevo-livebox.html On '''Orange''' site] :aka ''nuevo Livebox'' *[https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=39074 On the '''OpenWrt''' forums] :"P/N: 141751920003J R01" is silkscreened on the board in the images provided here. :74:31:70 OUI on the label, assumed 74:31:70 OUI for both interfaces :Model ARV7519RW22-A-LT :*[[Lantiq]] PEF 42068 V V1.2 (XWAY™ SLIC™120) telephony chip :*[[Lantiq]] PSB 80208 V V1.1 (ARX208) A/VSDL AFE :Most of the specs in here are courtesy of seguridadwireless forum users [http://foro.seguridadwireless.net/openwrt/astoria-networks-arv7519-de-ya-com-ahora-orange/ here] and [http://foro.seguridadwireless.net/openwrt/astoria-networks-arv7519-de-ya-com-ahora-orange/ here].
*[http://www.redeszone.net/routers/nuevo-router-multimedia-livebox-analisis-del-nuevo-router-de-orange-con-wi-fi-n-a-300mbps/ Review on '''redeszone.net'''] (ES) (good internal pictures) :Astoria Networks is the brand on the label, but the device was clearly manufactured by Arcadyan. :*[[Lantiq]] PSB 80208 V V1.1 (ARX208) ASDL chip :*[[Lantiq]] PEF 42068 VoIP chip *[http://www.xatakaon.com/modems-y-routers/nuevo-router-multimedia-livebox-de-orange-lo-hemos-probado On '''xatakaon.com'''](ES) :Chip markings: :* Wi-Fi Baseband+MAC chip: XWAY™ WAVE300 (PSB8231EL V1.1) (3x3 PCIe) :* Wi-Fi RF chip: XWAY™ WAVE300 (PSB 8304 V1.1) (3x3 2.4GHz) :This device has 1 Gigabit Ethernet port
